clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, Isabella summons newly awakened Forsaken mages to her in the ruined church. Her sealed scroll calls them to hone their volatile arcane powers.

Isabella calls newly awakened Forsaken mages to the ruined church in Deathknell. After you show an affinity for arcane magic while fighting the mindless Scourge nearby, the scroll bearing her arcane sigil bids you to report to her. Isabella trains local mages, and she knows that untrained magic can endanger the Forsaken as much as their enemies.

In Deathknell’s ruined chapel, Isabella teaches new Forsaken mages that undeath has not ended the dangers of arcane magic. Their bodies have lost the frailties of life, but magic remains volatile and corrupting. For the Forsaken, mastering the arcane is more than study. It can help them survive, seek vengeance, reclaim their destiny, and destroy those who threaten their fragile return to Lordaeron.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the mage trainer Isabella. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I knew you would come to me, friend. Not because you do not have the will to follow your own path, but because we are kindred spirits. We both have felt pain. We have both suffered. And now we want the power to take back what we know is ours: this land, our lives, our destinies. But there is much for you to learn still.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You must return to me often if you are to become powerful enough to destroy those who would oppose us. The rules of magic still apply to you, friend. You will still find corruption follows you like hungry wolves in the night. You will find its caress is not unlike an addiction, an old lover still wanting to be by your side. But these things can be staved off. These things will only control you if you allow them to.
Go now, return to me when you've grown more powerful.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
